we need to understand that the content, medium, and the pedagogy are all intertwined and interdependent.
the pedagogical method of teaching and learning with ICT is as important as using and integrating ICT tools in education.

the use of a blended learning/teaching approach is a promising strategy for enhancing student learning and performance in higher education.
